claims.claim: Faculty clients typically own the models developed for them, while Faculty retains rights to certain algorithms and libraries for other clients.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: In January 2026, Accenture agreed to acquire Faculty for over £740 million to improve its AI capabilities.
claims.quote: In January 2026, the consulting company [Accenture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Accenture "Accenture") agreed to acquire Faculty for over £740 million as it sought to improve the company's AI capabilities.
